title: Wisdom Literature
subtitle: Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Song of Solomon
theme: How to live in God’s world. Wisdom, meaning, and love as covenant life.
memoryText: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding.
reviewQuestions: What is the “fear of the LORD” and why is it the beginning of wisdom?
How does Ecclesiastes’s conclusion answer the problem of vanity?
How does Wisdom in Proverbs 8 point us toward Christ?
What is the Song of Solomon ultimately about, and how should we read it?
psalmsNote: Psalms 19 and 119 beside Proverbs. Psalms 49 and 73 beside Ecclesiastes. Psalm 45 beside the Song of Solomon.
